summary: Helus Pharma Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq and Cboe Canada under ticker HELP, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release announcing the completion of its legal name change from Cybin Inc. to Helus Pharma Inc., effective October 1, 2026, following shareholder approval at the annual and special meeting held September 22, 2026. No special-situation transaction is implicated; shares continue trading, outstanding certificates remain valid, and new CUSIP 423492107 and ISIN CA4234921076 were assigned. This is a routine corporate-identity housekeeping event with no deal terms, no risk-arb angle, and no actionable catalyst beyond ongoing HLP003 Phase 3 and HLP004 Phase 2 clinical progress.
